```{python}
fi_line = "Häijy on kaunis ja kaunis on häijy"
el_line = "Είν' τα ωραία φρίκη, φρίκη τα καλά"
en_line = "Fair is foul, and foul is fair"

def analyze_line(line, nlp):
    doc = nlp(line)
    results = []
    for token in doc:
        if token.is_alpha:
            results.append({
                "text": token.text,
                "lemma": token.lemma_,
                "POS": token.pos_,
                "morphology": str(token.morph)
            })
    return pd.DataFrame(results)

print("English")
display(analyze_line(en_line, nlp_en))
print("Finish")
display(analyze_line(fi_line, nlp_fi))
print("Greek")
display(analyze_line(el_line, nlp_el))
```
```{python}
category = wn.synset("body_part.n.01")

def body_part(df, lang):
    nouns = df[df["pos"] == "NOUN"]["lemma"].dropna().unique()
    body_parts = []
    for word in nouns:
        if is_a(word, category, lang):
            body_parts.append(word)
    return sorted(body_parts)

en_parts = body_part(en_df, "eng")
fi_parts = body_part(fi_df, "fin")
el_parts = body_part(el_df, "ell")

print("English Body Parts:", en_parts)
print("Finnish Body Parts:", fi_parts)
print("Greek Body Parts:", el_parts)
```
